verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a CLI processing-mode flag (`--mode accurate`) and webhooks for job completion, which implies async job handling. Nothing documents a fast synchronous mode that returns results in seconds, and no per-mode latency figures are published. Forge's "see results instantly" describes the in-app playground UI, not a synchronous API mode, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, a fast synchronous mode returns results in seconds for interactive apps, with latency documented per mode
